Premises:
MonkeypoxVirus(x) ::: x is the monkeypox virus.
Animal(x) ::: x is an animal.
Human(x) ::: x is a human.
Mammal(x) ::: x is a mammal.
Animal(x) ∧ Human(x) → Mammal(x) ::: Humans are mammals.
Symptom(x, fever) ::: Fever is a symptom of monkeypox.

Symptom(x, muscle pains) ::: Muscle pains are a symptom of monkeypox.
Symptom(x, feeling tired) ::: Feeling tired is a symptom of monkeypox.
FeelTired(x) ∧ GetsGlu(x) ::: People feel tired when they get a glu.

Conclusion:
Symptom(x, coughing) ::: Coughing is a symptom of monkeypox.
